# CA Sunil Kumar, FCA — NGO governance frameworks, books and IGMA™ toolkits

> Chartered Accountant and social-sector CFO with 30+ years in NGO and development-sector finance, audit and governance. Author of books on NGO governance, strategic finance and personal effectiveness, and creator of the IGMA™ (Institutional Governance Maturity Assessment) self-assessment toolkits, in public use since June 2026. This site sells books and self-assessment toolkits; it does not offer consulting or advisory services.

## Toolkits
- [IGMA™ toolkits and prices](https://sunilkumarfca.com/igma.html): Excel self-assessments for NGOs — institutional governance maturity ($500), FCRA compliance ($300), FCRA governance ($500), DPDP data protection ($100), compliance bundle ($700). Includes a 35-question FAQ.

## Books (several free to read online)
- [The Strategic CFO — read free](https://sunilkumarfca.com/read-the-strategic-cfo.html): strategic finance leadership for mission-driven organisations.
- [The Resilient Institution — read free](https://sunilkumarfca.com/read-the-resilient-institution.html): NGO governance, board oversight and institutional resilience.
- [The Wealthy Life — read free](https://sunilkumarfca.com/read-the-wealthy-life.html): building financial, physical, mental, emotional, social and spiritual wealth.
- [All books](https://sunilkumarfca.com/library.html) and [complete bibliography](https://sunilkumarfca.com/publications.html).

## Knowledge Hub
- [Knowledge Hub](https://sunilkumarfca.com/notes.html): all topics.
- [Institutional Governance & Resilience](https://sunilkumarfca.com/ngo-governance.html): NGO governance, Board oversight, resilience and governance maturity.
- [FCRA Governance](https://sunilkumarfca.com/fcra-governance.html): FCRA compliance as an institutional governance responsibility.
- [The Strategic CFO](https://sunilkumarfca.com/strategic-finance-ngos.html): Strategic finance, the CFO role, budgeting and cash flow in NGOs.
- [Governance maturity: key concepts](https://sunilkumarfca.com/governance-maturity.html): the IGMA™ scale, evidence-based criteria and the Governance Perception Gap™.
